result.description: A fictional desktop memory kit built for older mainstream systems, the Nova Loom pairing delivers 8GB total capacity as 2 matched 4GB modules running at DDR3 speeds. It is designed for simple drop-in upgrades on compatible motherboards, emphasizing stable everyday performance over enthusiast overclocking. The low-profile heat spreaders are intended to fit beneath large CPU coolers, and the kit is sold as a matched dual-channel set for easy installation.
result.title: Nova Loom 2x4GB DDR3 Desktop Memory Kit
